result.summary: Identified 2 minor visual and layout issues on the food delivery screen.

issues.description: Restaurant cards feature placeholder vector illustrations instead of real food photos.
issues.suggestion: Replace illustration graphics with high-resolution food photography.

issues.description: Text label 'Trattoria Piccolo' is clipped by the screen boundary in the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll padding to prevent awkward text truncation at screen edges.
